integrity: The analytical density proof is self-contained. Finite rational-arithmetic and integer checks supplement, but do not replace, the symbolic argument. Independent mathematical verification has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proves an exact nondecrease density only for shifts \(2^k-1\). Does not prove the all-shift conjecture or classify the entire change distribution. Existing general distribution recurrences are an implication/priority risk.
title: Exact Mersenne-shift bias for adjacent-one counts in binary expansions
